basic_info.description: Brand new Residence 103 with incredible Private 460 sq ft patio attached to the living room ideal for outdoor living and entertaining. The Belvedere features a panoramic Golden Gate view bridge and SF skyline roof deck spanning the Entire roof with numerous seating areas for coffee, dining and two large BBQs. This unit is truly turn-key with Custom closets and custom motorized shades newly installed. Both bedrooms are en-suite with an additional 1/2 bath for guests. The high-end kitchen includes Miele appliances and a large, gorgeous Quartzite island flowing to the living space. In-unit washer/dryer, additional storage, bicycle storage and trash service included in rent. This unit uniquely provides the best of both worlds of elegant outdoor living spaces with its own large exclusive patio surrounded by trees and access to an expansive roof deck. Parking is available for an additional fee. The Belvedere offers front desk service, in a perfectly located walking area with the restaurants and shops of Union Street, Polk Street of Russian Hill, and the Marina just minutes away. Contact Selma Bushell, Associate Broker #101510129
